text: Window honesty: the runoff (2 November) displaced the economic cycle, so five of the seven items above are "still not tabled / nothing promulgated" statements — that is the news for a weekend window. ДВ has not published since 30 October, so the €660 МРЗ ordinance and the ЗПС repeal are in force or pending publication, not promulgated as of this brief.
